description: This file defines the Java class 'AmqpCommandEndpointConfiguration' which extends 'CommandEndpointConfiguration'. It provides configuration properties for testing Command & Control scenarios over AMQP in the Eclipse Hono project, including methods for creating configuration instances, generating string representations, and obtaining subscription addresses for devices.

classes.name: AmqpCommandEndpointConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for AMQP command endpoint testing scenarios, extending CommandEndpointConfiguration and adding specific methods.

methods.name: AmqpCommandEndpointConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the configuration with specific roles and endpoint usage flags.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration, including role and endpoint information.

methods.name: getSubscriptionAddress
methods.description: Constructs and returns the subscription address for a device or gateway based on tenant and device IDs.
